description: Remove a temporary DNS name now, before its 24 hours are up. Needs the dns_token. Use it when the work is done and the name should stop answering rather than sit there until it expires. The removal reaches the primary name server at once and the secondary follows by replication, so a disconnected secondary can keep answering until it reconnects or the name expires. A resolver that already holds the answer keeps it for the rest of its TTL, at most 60 seconds.

dns_token.description: The dns_token from create_dns_name. It is shown once and never again.

slug.description: The slug the service assigned, without the aisense- prefix and without the zone.

name: delete_dns_name
title: Delete a temporary DNS name
